# bhalophone

> AI-powered phone recommendations for Bangladesh. Best-phone
> guides for every budget, ranked from live Bangladesh shop data:
> real in-stock status across 8+ BD shops, prices confirmed against
> trusted sellers, rankings from review + spec evidence. Rebuilt
> nightly; last data check 2026-07-20. Ranking is never for sale.
